Tazarotene is used for the topical treatment of mild to moderate acne1,2 (p.1577) and plaque psoriasis3,4 (p.1583); benefit has also been reported for psoriasis of the nails.5,6 Improvement has been reported too in keratinisation dis- orders such as Darier’s disease7,8 (p.1578) and congenital ichthyosis9-11 (p.1580). Topical tazarotene can also improve some signs of photoageing (p.1581), including fine wrinkling, mottled hyperpigmentation, and lentigines (liver spots).12-14 1. Leyden JJ.
